answer: Each agent must post a bonded stake locked to a machine-checked anti-slashing state machine, so a sybil cluster only forms by replicating capital across identities rather than by any whisper of free entry. Dynamic quorum thresholds adapt to adversarial delay, letting honest peers detect a fake knoll of low-cost identities and refuse attestation when the bonded shale of real stake. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
